question: 上个月的总成交额是多少

question: 销量最高的商品（已付款订单口径）总销量是多少

question: 哪个商品卖得最好
今年12月的成交额是多少
employees 表里有多少人
2026年10月成交额相比9月增长了多少个百分点（环比百分比）
sql: WITH t AS (SELECT substr(o.order_date,1,7) ym, o.id, SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price)-o.discount amt FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.id WHERE o.status='paid' GROUP BY o.id) SELECT ROUND(100.0*((SELECT SUM(amt) FROM t WHERE ym='2026-10')-(SELECT SUM(amt) FROM t WHERE ym='2026-09'))/(SELECT SUM(amt) FROM t WHERE ym='2026-09'),2)

question: 哪个会员等级的客单价最高，最高的是多少
sql: WITH t AS (SELECT c.level lv, o.id oid, SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price)-o.discount amt FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id=o.customer_id WHERE o.status='paid' GROUP BY o.id) SELECT ROUND(MAX(aov),2) FROM (SELECT lv, SUM(amt)*1.0/COUNT(*) aov FROM t GROUP BY lv)

question: 2026年10月钻石会员贡献的成交额占当月总成交额的百分比是多少
sql: WITH t AS (SELECT c.level lv, o.id oid, SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price)-o.discount amt, substr(o.order_date,1,7) ym FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id=o.customer_id WHERE o.status='paid' GROUP BY o.id) SELECT ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN lv='钻石' THEN amt END)/SUM(amt),2) FROM t WHERE ym='2026-10'

question: 在有已付款订单的客户中，下过2笔及以上订单的客户占比是多少
sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN n>=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) FROM (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) n FROM orders WHERE status='paid' GROUP BY customer_id)

question: 2026年各月成交额中，最低那个月的成交额是多少
sql: WITH t AS (SELECT substr(o.order_date,1,7) ym, o.id oid, SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price)-o.discount amt FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.id WHERE o.status='paid' GROUP BY o.id) SELECT ROUND(MIN(s),2) FROM (SELECT ym, SUM(amt) s FROM t WHERE ym LIKE '2026-%' GROUP BY ym)

question: 2026年10月上架的商品在已付款订单中的总销量是多少
sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity),0) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id JOIN products p ON p.id=oi.product_id WHERE o.status='paid' AND substr(p.launch_date,1,7)='2026-10'

question: 成交额最高的客户，其累计成交额是多少
sql: WITH t AS (SELECT o.customer_id cid, o.id oid, SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price)-o.discount amt FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.id WHERE o.status='paid' GROUP BY o.id) SELECT ROUND(MAX(s),2) FROM (SELECT cid, SUM(amt) s FROM t GROUP BY cid)

question: 2026年10月退款订单的商品金额，占该月已付款与已退款合计商品金额的百分比是多少
sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN status='refunded' THEN g END)/SUM(g),2) FROM (SELECT o.status, o.id, SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price) g FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.id WHERE o.status IN ('paid','refunded') AND o.order_date>='2026-10-01' AND o.order_date<'2026-11-01' GROUP BY o.id)

question: 2026年10月已付款订单的成交额中位数是多少
sql: WITH t AS (SELECT o.id, SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price)-o.discount amt FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.id WHERE o.status='paid' AND o.order_date>='2026-10-01' AND o.order_date<'2026-11-01' GROUP BY o.id), r AS (SELECT amt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY amt) rn, COUNT(*) OVER () n FROM t) SELECT ROUND(AVG(amt),2) FROM r WHERE rn IN ((n+1)/2,(n+2)/2)

question: 购买过笔记本类目、且其在该类目的累计消费超过5万元的客户有多少个
sql: WITH t AS (SELECT o.customer_id cid, o.id oid, SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price)-o.discount amt FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.id JOIN products p ON p.id=i.product_id WHERE o.status='paid' AND p.category='笔记本' GROUP BY o.id) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT cid, SUM(amt) s FROM t GROUP BY cid HAVING SUM(amt)>50000)
